english.title: Company/officer fail to ensure company's registered email address is appropriate email address
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[a company,]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely, **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 88A of the Companies Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) If a company fails to comply with the duty in section 88A of the Companies Act 2005, an offence is committed by the company, and every officer of the company who is in default (section 88A(3)).
(ii) An email address is an 'appropriate email address' if, in the ordinary course of events, emails sent to it by the registrar would be expected to come to the attention of a person acting on behalf of the company (section 88A(2)).
(iii) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.
